title: Bear cub dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#1c2a45'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='72' width='12' height='18' rx='6' fill='#a8743f'/>
  <rect x='54' y='72' width='12' height='18' rx='6' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- paw pads -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e8b984'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f2cd9e'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#f2cd9e'/>
  <!-- left arm raised up -->
  <g transform='rotate(-35 32 50)'>
    <rect x='26' y='38' width='11' height='22' rx='5.5' fill='#b57c45'/>
    <circle cx='31.5' cy='38' r='6.5' fill='#e8b984'/>
  </g>
  <!-- right arm raised up -->
  <g transform='rotate(35 68 50)'>
    <rect x='63' y='38' width='11' height='22' rx='5.5' fill='#d99a58'/>
    <circle cx='68.5' cy='38' r='6.5' fill='#f2cd9e'/>
  </g>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='17' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='14' r='7' fill='#b57c45'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='14' r='3.5' fill='#f2cd9e'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='14' r='7' fill='#d99a58'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='14' r='3.5' fill='#f2cd9e'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#f2cd9e'/>
  <!-- eyes happy -->
  <path d='M42 24 q3 -4 6 0' stroke='#5a3a1e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 24 q3 -4 6 0' stroke='#5a3a1e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='31' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#5a3a1e'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M46 35 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#5a3a1e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='31' r='2.5' fill='#f09a8a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='31' r='2.5' fill='#f09a8a'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#7ee0c8'>
    <circle cx='82' cy='22' r='3'/>
    <rect x='84' y='10' width='2' height='12'/>
    <circle cx='18' cy='34' r='2.5'/>
    <rect x='19.5' y='24' width='1.8' height='10'/>
  </g>
</svg>
